text:
devon: Quick check — we have two new open models in intake (gamma-3.5 and poppy-7b). Need to confirm owners, licensing clearance, perf profiles, and quantization test owners so they can go into the catalog launch next Tuesday. Who can pick which? :eyes:
sasha: I'll take gamma-3.5 for perf and quantization. Planning to run a 512/1024 seq sweep tomorrow. Will post numbers. :thumbsup:
anita: Legal here — I have the license scans for both but need confirmation on redistribution clause for poppy-7b. Can the owner drop the model card link?
devon: model cards: gamma-3.5 -> https://models.local/gamma-3.5/card, poppy-7b -> https://models.local/poppy-7b/card
anita: thanks. I'll review poppy's redistrib clause today, ETA EOD. If it's a problem we can gate the catalog entry.
jordan: FYI perf notes: early runs of poppy-7b on q4-bit give ~1.7x throughput but token-level F1 drops ~0.9% on our eval set vs fp16. Need an accuracy regression sign-off. I'll add the eval logs to the PR.
sasha: noted. I'll do a quantization parity test on gamma-3.5 and run the standard eval harness:
```
./bench/run_eval.sh --model gamma-3.5 --seqlen 512 --quantize q4_0 --batch 4
```
Should catch regressions.
maya: Infra/ingest: staging ingest for these models is queued, but we need an ingest-owner to finish the manifest (licenses, shas). Whoever claims them, please add a manifest comment. ingest-bot will reject incomplete manifests.
devon: i'll own poppy-7b manifest and small patching for ingest. Will add shas + license tag by EOD.
anita: devon — once you add license tag I'll do the redistrib check; if clean, I'll mark legal:approved.
jordan: Sasha — can you run the baseline fp16 vs q4 report and paste the key metric table here? Need to decide if 0.9% drop is acceptable for catalog.
sasha: will push numbers by 11:30 PT. Quick heads-up: gamma-3.5 quantized run had a memory edge-case on p3.8x with KV cache; workaround is to force chunked-kv. I'll note in the perf ticket.
devon: PR for ingest manifest (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/4212 — comments welcome.
ingest-bot: Manifest validation: 2 missing fields (license_tag, sha256). See CI details.
maya: thanks bot. devon, you'll need to re-run manifest CI after adding tags.
devon: on it. ETA 45m.
anita: action items I have: review poppy redistribution, confirm whether we can host artifact in S3 or need downstream-only link. If S3 ok, catalog entry is simpler.
jordan: action: I'll review eval diffs and propose a fallback profile (fp16 fallback) if q4 regresses too much in real queries.
sasha: action: run final 512/1024 parity and paste table here. Also will open a tiny doc with recommended quantization profile for gamma-3.5.
devon: action: finish manifest + license_tag and ping legal. Also assign owner field in the intake form to me for poppy.
maya: I'll ensure staging ingest slot is reserved for EOD and unblock deployment once manifest CI passes.
devon: thanks everyone. If legal blocks redistrib we can still include metadata (no-hosting) and mark as "catalog: reference-only" — prefer to avoid that for launch but ok fallback.
anita: noted. I'll escalate if needed.
jordan: sounds good. If everyone posts their updates here I can consolidate a short status note for product before COB. :white_check_mark:
sasha: posting initial table now (short):
- gamma-3.5 fp16: latency 78ms @ batch1 seq512, q4: 55ms. eval F1 fp16 0.823, q4 0.821
- poppy-7b fp16: latency 240ms @ batch1 seq512, q4: 140ms. eval F1 fp16 0.792, q4 0.784
(putting full logs in PR)
devon: good data, thanks. I'll wait for legal on poppy and then we can finalize catalog entries.
anita: started review, will update here.
maya: will take final deploy step after manifest CI green.
jordan: ping me when legal:approved and I'll run a final canary with user prompts.
devon: will do. End-of-thread checkpoint: owners assigned (sasha perf/gamma, devon ingest/poppy, jordan eval fallback, anita legal, maya ingest infra). Target: catalog publish next Tue if no legal stops.
